description: This file defines a chat interface component for a React-based web application, including UI elements, user interaction handlers, and state management for chat conversations, prompts, themes, and media uploads.

classes.name: SessionConfigModel
classes.description: A modal component allowing users to edit session configurations, including masks and memories.

classes.name: PromptToast
classes.description: A component showing prompt hints and modal toggle for context configuration.

classes.name: _Chat
classes.description: Main chat component managing message display, input, user interactions, and state.

classes.name: Chat
classes.description: Wrapper component that renders the _Chat component with current session index context.

methods.name: useSubmitHandler
methods.description: Hook to handle keyboard events and determine if submit action should be triggered.

methods.name: PromptHints
methods.description: Component providing keyboard navigation for prompt suggestions.

methods.name: ClearContextDivider
methods.description: Component rendering a divider to clear chat context.

methods.name: ChatAction
methods.description: Button component representing a chat action (e.g., stop, retry, delete).

methods.name: useScrollToBottom
methods.description: Hook enabling auto scroll behaviors in chat view.

methods.name: ChatActions
methods.description: Component rendering set of chat-related actions such as theme switching, model selection, and uploading images.

methods.name: EditMessageModal
methods.description: Modal for editing a message's content and topic.

methods.name: DeleteImageButton
methods.description: Button component for deleting an attached image.

methods.description: Main component handling rendering of chat messages, input area, media, and user interactions.
